title: Front Office Executive (Hotel)
summary: Runs the hotel front desk: checking guests in and out, handling reservations, settling bills and answering guest requests. Sits in the Rooms team under the front office manager and works closely with housekeeping and reservations.
dailyDuties: Check guests in and out and assign rooms
Update guest profiles, room moves and billing in Opera or IDS
Take and amend room reservations and group rooming lists
Settle guest folios and close the cashier shift
Submit C-Forms for foreign guests and keep the arrival and departure register
Coordinate with housekeeping on room readiness for arrivals
Hand over the shift log and open guest requests

skills.expectation: Check guests in and out quickly, including early arrivals, room moves and late check-outs
Work daily in a hotel PMS such as Opera or IDS for arrivals, profiles and billing
Take, change and cancel room reservations and handle group rooming lists
Post charges, settle guest folios and close the cashier shift without differences
Understand night audit steps and the daily revenue reports it produces
Submit C-Forms for foreign guests on time and keep the arrival and departure register current
Resolve guest requests and complaints at the desk and on the phone
Speak clearly with guests in English and at least one Indian language
Offer room upgrades and hotel services at check-in
Calm upset guests and hand over to the duty manager when needed
Log and return guest lost property
Keep simple shift reports in Excel
